one_line: Close on steady close-ups of the dedication page and the cover with the child's name.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static medium shot: a woman and a man on the floor, a baby on his lap, unwrapping a white gift before mermaid balloons and a big "1". Voice and subtitle together (transcript): "ביום ההולדת הראשון של" ... "שהיא לא רק עוד צעצוע".
q1_hook.why: A real family moment with faces from frame one, voice and subtitle opening together (H4, H6, K8). "Not just another toy" opens a small gap about the gift (H5). But no book is visible until 0:07, so the value shows around 0:10, and the first cut is at 7.4 s (S1, H2, E1).

beats.what: Two parents unwrap a white gift, the baby on a lap; "שהיא לא רק עוד צעצוע"
beats.why: A held-back reveal with a family around it

beats.what: The father holds the book open, the baby reaches; "ואז הגיע הספר הזה"
beats.why: The gift is named at last

beats.what: Both parents hold the open book, the baby points and laughs; "עם השם שלה, הדמות שלה"
beats.why: Personalisation said while a child reacts

beats.what: The baby turns a page, parents laugh; "זה היה הרגע הכי מרגש בשבילנו"
beats.why: The emotional peak, left uncut for 3 s

beats.what: Parents kiss; the father holds the closed book, the FunSome cover to the lens, the baby hugs it
beats.why: A warm beat, and the brand seen once

beats.what: Close-up of the dedication page with the illustrated family; "מאמא ואבא שתשאר איתה לתמיד"
Cover with the child's name, then two spreads; "זו באמת אחת המתנות הכי מיוחדות"
beats.why: A closing image, but no ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "מה המתנה הכי מרגשת שקיבלו הילדים שלכן?", an open question about the viewer's own life. Nothing in the video asks for a comment, send or save.
q2_flow.why: The gift stays wrapped for 7 s and the book arrives as a small reveal, then a laugh (H5, K2). The peak sits at 0:21 to 0:25, with proof close-ups after it, not at the very end (R4). The first 13 s give no clear look at the book (H2, R3).

q3_cta.what: None in the video; the last subtitle is "לבחור לה" (0:36). Caption: the question "מה המתנה הכי מרגשת שקיבלו הילדים שלכן?" and a thank-you to @funsomeil. No code, link or how-to-order.
q3_cta.why: One open question that a parent can answer from life (C5, R6), but it is about gifts in general, not the book, so comments drift from the product. The video never says or shows where to get it, so a moved viewer has no next step (C6).

q4_shown.what: A gift unwrapped by two parents with a baby, 0:00-0:07; the book held open and read together; the baby turning a page; the closed FunSome cover; the dedication page with an illustrated family; the cover title with the child's name; two spreads. No price.
q4_shown.why: The parents' first-person voice and the baby's laugh are first-hand proof (S6). The dedication page and the named cover come only after 0:28, with no photo beside them (S2). The book is first handled at 0:07 (S1). Two parents' faces and the baby's, with a name, go against S5.

q5_edit.what: 9 shots in 37.3 s, about 4.1 s each: five family shots to 0:29, then four handheld book close-ups. Hard cuts, no speed changes seen. One-line subtitles, one word highlighted in a purple box at a time. Ends on a spread.
q5_edit.why: The first cut comes at 7.4 s, a long static hold (E1, R1). Word highlights follow the voice, so it works muted (E4). A cut about every 4 s, with the peak uncut for 3 s, is a moderate pace (E2). No dead tail after the last line (E8).

q6_topic.what: A first-birthday gift: parents show the personalised book they gave their baby, and her reaction. It serves gift buyers and parents of one-year-olds.
q6_topic.why: A named occasion with the buyers shown is a clear buying moment (K7), and a gift idea is easy to send on (R5). A laughing baby is the warm peak (K1, K8). "שישאר איתה כשתגדל" is a modest, emotional claim (K4).

q7_filmed.what: A static eye-level medium shot of two parents and a baby on a tiled floor before mermaid balloons, in window light; a slightly high handheld shot; then handheld top-down close-ups of the book on a patterned cloth.
q7_filmed.why: A real party set-up and both parents' faces look native (H8, F7), and the static frame keeps everyone in view (K8). The book is small until the closing close-ups, and the dedication page is shot at an angle (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: White one-line subtitles, one word at a time in a purple box, about 78% down: "ביום ההולדת הראשון של" (0:00), "שהיא לא רק עוד צעצוע" (0:03), "ואז הגיע הספר הזה" (0:08), "שבו היא ממש הדמות" (0:10), "ואפילו גם אנחנו מופיעים בתוכו כמשפחה" (0:15), "זה היה הרגע הכי מרגש בשבילנו" (0:23), "מאמא ואבא שתשאר איתה לתמיד" (0:29), "לבחור לה" (0:36). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: Opens on the first birthday and the child's name, then "בחרנו מתנה שהיא הרבה מעבר לעוד צעצוע 💜". About 60 words in short paragraphs: the book, a question, a thank-you to @funsomeil, 4 hashtags. No code, no disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Subtitles echo the voice, so it works muted (T1, T2), but they sit in the bottom 35%, over the family and the book (T4, F2). No headline card promises anything (T3). The caption has occasion and product words, a question and 4 hashtags (T7, C5), but only a thank-you, no disclosure (T8).

weak_points: The book appears only at 0:07 and the name page at 0:29; a 7 s static opening; no price, code or where to buy; a general caption question; no disclosure word; faces and the child's name together.
lumebook_takeaway: Without a child, open on the close-ups instead: the dedication page, the cover with the name, a spread, with the voice line over them.
not_verified: Whether they are the baby's parents; whether the collaboration is paid (the caption only thanks the brand contact); music; where the book is sold. The child's name is in the subtitle at 0:01, the dedication, the cover and the caption, not quoted. The coded file agrees with the frames.
